limits: MDTraj public read decodes available fields for one selected row, including unrequested fields. This establishes bounded coordinate reads, not optimal selective-column I/O or total-RSS benchmarking.

Query axes permit order/repeats; native inventory extraction retains its separate unique-atom contract. source structure positions are not authenticated source IDs.
